name: Urukku Manush v2.2.1
changelog:
• Complete Retro Arcade Parchment Cabinet remodel for Game Settings, Worldwide Leaderboard, Activation Wizard, Update Center, Paused Menu, and Game Over Screen.
• Sleek 3D arcade buttons with slim bevels, pixel borders, and touch depression feedback across all screens.
• Native vector SVG icon set for crisp rendering at any resolution.
• Multi-device push notification token support with comma/slash delimiter parsing.
• Scrollable patch notes in Update Wizard with direct single-scroll navigation.
